value.account: Two causes. (1) orchestrator/workflow/validation.py _validate_repeat_until_on_exhausted: from 2.29 the compiler emits a generated ref to an __exhausted_placeholders step for the inactive path variant's relpath output, but the 'may only override scalar outputs' relpath check ran before the exact-generated-ref allowance. I moved the generated-ref check first. It still only accepts the exact compiler-captured ref when the compiler-owned flag is set, so authored relpath overrides (literal or hand-written ref) are still rejected. (2) After that the run failed: at 2.29+ the final result join reads result__* from the loop frame (at 2.28 it reads state__* directly), and on exhaustion the loop frame stored on_exhausted override refs unresolved ({'ref': ...}), so return__rounds failed integer validation. orchestrator/workflow/loops.py repeat_until_exhaustion_artifacts now (version >= 2.29 only) resolves ref overrides: self-refs from the exhaustion state snapshot, other refs through executor._resolve_ref_value; unresolved refs are left as-is so they still fail downstream. 2.28 and earlier take the old path unchanged. Tests: tests/test_workflow_lisp_loop_result_path_exhaustion.py (compile at 2.28-2.32, exhaustion and APPROVE run at 2.28/2.29/2.32 with mocked provider). Ran that module plus rich_loop_values_e2e, loader_validation, lowering, strict_boolean e2e, executor_characterization: 502 passed. Considered: dropping the relpath rejection entirely (rejected, weakens validation); making the compiler not emit the placeholder ref (would just recreate 2.28 literal inlining, but the placeholder step exists deliberately for rich values); resolving refs at the join (broader runtime change). Not covered: no dedicated test that an authored relpath on_exhausted override is rejected (relied on existing loader tests and unchanged gating); I did not run 2.30/2.31 end-to-end runs (only compile); no resume-after-exhaustion test; I did not run the full suite.
value.summary: Loop results with a path field in a non-exhausted union variant now compile and run identically at targets 2.29-2.32 as at 2.28, via two small fixes in validation.py and loops.py plus new regression tests.

notes: La prueba nueva contiene una rama muerta en la construcción de argv y una importación innecesaria.
No hay prueba específica de reanudación tras agotamiento ni del rechazo de una referencia relpath redactada a mano; no bloquea esta corrección.
